positive_feedback: ParsedSharedLen { Lit(u32), Hole(String) } is exactly the minimal-sound representation the spec called for: parser.rs's two call sites (parse_shared_type_args, parse_shared_decl_stmt) each handle it correctly -- type-position collapses Hole to the documented placeholder 1 (unreachable downstream anyway), decl-stmt carries (len=1, len_hole=Some(name)) additively.

SharedDecl.len_hole threading is genuinely additive: SharedTy.len stays u32 everywhere (shared.rs, typecheck.rs's register_shared/check_shared_decl_stmt gained a parameter but no existing call-site semantics changed), and every touch-site doc-comment correctly cross-references the invariant ('ty.len stays u32', 'placeholder 1').

The lower.rs hole-ref validation (UndefinedStrategyHole against declared @strategy holes) and typecheck.rs's aggregate-shared-byte skip (`if !tc.shared_decls.iter().any(|s| s.len_hole.is_some())`) both mirror the spec's cited @workgroup-hole precedent exactly, including the comment linking them.
